nodes.scope: Existing Accepted ADR0028 revision2 D8 retained transport helper ceiling only: max2 retries total, rate-limit max2, service-unavailable max1, timeout/ineligible no new retry category. Old phase/psyche/agency/model policies outside this scope; awareness latest policy keeps zero automatic retry.

Only tested lexical/status/cause-chain error classification and capped retry-header delay; rate limit precedence over 403 billing interpretation. No factual diagnosis of actual provider/account incident, application-result class or complete header/date branches certified.

Only bounded invocation of the same supplied operation callback: max2 rate-limit retries, max1 service-unavailable within total2, known nonretryable failure rethrows exact error, canRetry false refuses. Default first two rate-limit backoff waits tested via injected sleep. No live HTTP, provider identity proof from callback, all mixed sequences, observer accounting or activation for no-retry awareness calls.

All three local tests: 429/503/abort/402/403-credit/DNS cause/syntax classification, 403 rate limit not billing, retry headers2s/cap10s/missing. Classification is test of reported fields, not verified remote root cause; no retry activated.

All four local fake-operation tests: rate-limit two retries and injected waits1s/2s, 503 one retry and original failure, timeout/billing/DNS/parse zero retries, canRetry false once. No actual streaming fixture or provider identity/HTTP, account quota, complete mixed failures or latest awareness retry activation.
